headline: Chainalysis breach exposes customer credentials and tokens
summary: Blockchain intelligence firm Chainalysis said hackers used an AI-agent-driven "on-path" attack to steal credentials and live tokens for all of its customers, tools that are also routinely used to support police investigations.

claims.statement: Chainalysis said a cyberattack on its systems stole credentials and tokens for all of its customers.

sources.quote: Chainalysis says breach exposed credentials for all customers
Chainalysis says hackers stole credentials and tokens for all of its customers

claims.statement: The attack involved an AI-agent-driven "on-path" intrusion.

sources.quote: Agentic 'on-path attack' went after Chainalysis's tools
Company said a "multifront cyberattack" included AI agents and an on-path data snatch.
